visualCharacteristics: Full-width light-grey (#f1f1f2) panel: hidden validation alert, search row (search icon, text input with product autocomplete, Search button; hidden below 576px), then a 'Browse Products' listbox that cascades into Product Family / Product Line / Product Model selects stacked full width, and a Submit button shown only when a leaf product is chosen.
contentPattern: Nine single-cell rows read in order: 1) product data file link (default /data/amd-driver-products.json); 2) search placeholder; 3) search button label; 4-7) level labels (Browse Products, Product Family, Product Line, Product Model); 8) submit label; 9) validation message. Cells are read in document order, so grouped multi-cell rows also work. All form controls are built in JS; the product tree comes from the JSON file { categories:[{title,url?,items}], products:[{title,url}] }.

structure.note: Empty cells fall back to the default labels.
structure.model: driver-selector: dataSource, searchPlaceholder, searchLabel, browseLabel, familyLabel, lineLabel, modelLabel, submitLabel, validationMessage

usage.description: Interactive product finder: search with autocomplete plus cascading category > family > line > model selects that navigate to the product's driver page.

reuseGuidance: Use wherever visitors pick a product from the AMD product tree (drivers, documentation). Point the data cell at a JSON file with the categories/products schema; maintain the tree in that file, not in the block.
